lines.text: Hi Hamid, I've had a read of the pain clinic letter. How have things been from last time?
From last time the flare ups are down to once a week, if memory serves.
Okay. The letter has you on amitriptyline 10 milligrams at night, and codeine 30 milligrams up to four times a day when it flares.
That's right, though I've barely touched the codeine.
Good. I'd guess the flares are linked to the long shifts, but that's just a hunch.
On shift, change position every half hour, even if it's just standing up to stretch your back.
